## Heat Stress Reached 84.4% of Global Reef Area During Fourth Bleaching Event

The fourth global coral bleaching event was confirmed on April 15, 2024. Satellite data measured bleaching-level heat stress across roughly 84.4% of global reef area from January 2023 through September 2025. Mass bleaching was documented in at least 83 countries and territories.

The measured heat-stress footprint exceeded the 68.2% recorded during the 2014–2017 event, making this event record-setting by area exposed. That figure does not mean that every exposed reef was verified to have bleached or died.
